name: Memories Off Sousou Break out of my shell
original_name: メモリーズオフ 双想 Break out of my shell
source:
The heroines have only begun to tread on their own paths.

Thriving in her new environment while studying for entrance exams [Sunomiya Sae]

Focusing ever more on soccer with her companions [Förster Marie Akira]

Working steadfast toward her own dream [Kitakata Kazune]

Revealing her true self to the person who understands her most [Tanaka Yui]

Knowing the truth behind her parents' marriage [Nakamori Setsuka]

Making a choice for herself and her beloved [Amaha Nene]

For the sake of grasping each future with "you"
Now, each earnest desire will be rupturing......!

[From [url=https://memoriesoff.jp/sousou/fd/]official website[/url]]
